fields.finding: Figure 5 starts near 7500 MPa as labeled. The base uses the declared factor-of-ten interpretation (750 MPa) and J2 plasticity; the literal axis is a separate sensitivity.
fields.consequence: No unique sourced steel plasticity curve was recovered. The axis correction is not an established erratum. The plotted tensile curve is also transferred symmetrically to compression through the J2 assumption.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
